name: New Era Cap Company (New Era Cap Co., LLC)
note: Buffalo, New York headwear company controlled by its founding Koch family - Christopher H. Koch is the fourth-generation CEO of the family-owned company (Jackie Robinson Foundation board bio). Not related to Koch Industries of Kansas. In August 2022 ACON Investments closed a ~$700 million continuation round under which the NFL, NBA and MLB became minority investors (Front Office Sports, 2022-08-07; theparkwholesale.com hat guide, 2024-06).
